reports.place: Gulf of Montijo / near Coiba Island
reports.title: Strong M6.6 aftershock west of Azuero (IGC: M6.9)
reports.summary: USGS recorded an M6.6 aftershock at 20:25 UTC (15:25 local), depth 10 km, between Coiba Island and the Gulf of Montijo; USGS PAGER alert yellow, max MMI ~8. IGC-UP reported it as M6.9, 32 km from Coiba. No damage or injury reports linked to it yet.

reports.title: More than 50 aftershocks recorded
reports.summary: Infobae reports over 50 aftershocks following the main shock, including the M6.9 (IGC) event near Coiba.

reports.title: Museo de la Nacionalidad (Casa del Cabildo) damaged
reports.summary: The national-heritage Museo de la Nacionalidad in La Villa de Los Santos suffered damage to its roof and stairs, alongside the damaged San Atanasio church.

reports.title: CSS reports no injuries or deaths in its system
reports.summary: The Social Security Fund (CSS) reported no injuries or casualties from the earthquake, per Telemetro's live blog (15:45 local). This is not a national balance.

reports.title: ETESA: transmission network stable
reports.summary: ETESA said the national electricity transmission network remains stable; local distribution outages reported earlier in six provinces are separate.

reports.title: Panama City suspends municipal services; Centenario bridge inspected
reports.summary: Panama City municipality suspended all municipal services, including markets, until further notice. Minister Dinoska Montalvo said inspections of the Puente Centenario are under way and warned against misinformation.
